title: Finite normalization of a generic tensor field factor over a finite normal domain extension
statement: Let $B$ be a commutative domain with fraction field $K$. Let $A$ be a Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] normal domain [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring] and a finite faithful $B$-algebra: $A$ is a finitely generated $B$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] and $B\to A$ is injective. Let $E/K$ be a finite separable field extension [def-pc-field-extension, def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension], and give $E$ the composite $B$-algebra structure. For every maximal ideal $P$ of $D=E\otimes_B A$, give $F=D/P$ its $A$-algebra structure by the right tensor inclusion. Then the integral closure [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure] of $A$ in $F$ is a finitely generated $A$-module.

source.place: Tag 032L (lemma-Noetherian-normal-domain-finite-separable-extension), applied after the finite separable tensor-factor calculation.

proof.text: Set K=Frac(B). Since A is finite over B, E tensor_B A and its maximal quotient F are finite-dimensional over E, hence over K. The structural map K -> F is injective because F is a field. The kernel of A -> F therefore contracts to zero in B. Integrality of A over B and Ideal.eq_bot_of_comap_eq_bot make this kernel zero. This gives the unique compatible Frac(A)-algebra structure on F.

The two field maps give a Frac(A)-algebra map Frac(A) tensor_K E -> F. It is surjective: quotient surjectivity and tensor induction reduce to e tensor_B a, which is the image of a tensor_K e. The K-algebra structures agree by uniqueness of maps from Frac(B). F is finite-dimensional over Frac(A) by restriction of scalars.

Finite separability of E/K gives formal unramifiedness; base change to Frac(A) and the proved tensor surjection preserve formal unramifiedness. The field criterion gives separability of F/Frac(A). Apply [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-normal-separable-integral-closure-finite], implemented by IsIntegralClosure.finite, to obtain the finite A-module integralClosure A F.

theorem dvr_root_tensor_factor_integralClosure_finite
    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [IsDomain B]
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsIntegrallyClosed A]
    [IsNoetherianRing A] [Algebra B A] [Module.Finite B A] [FaithfulSMul B A]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (FractionRing B) E]
    (hE : FiniteDimensional (FractionRing B) E ∧ Algebra.IsSeparable (FractionRing B) E) :
    let : Algebra B E :=
      ((algebraMap (FractionRing B) E).comp (algebraMap B (FractionRing B))).toAlgebra
    let D := E ⊗[B] A
    ∀ (P : Ideal D) (hP : P.IsMaximal),
    let := hP
    let F := D ⧸ P
    let alpha : A →+* F := (Ideal.Quotient.mk P).comp
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : A →ₐ[B] D).toRingHom
    let := alpha.toAlgebra
    Module.Finite A (integralClosure A F)
